matches.name: sheetpane-rules-file
matches.description: Use when valid and invalid values ship as a JSON file per sheet, column or cell, checked on load and listed only in the errors panel - rules / rules-src, its JSON Schema, flagging="off". Not for rules written in code (sheetpane-column-rules).

matches.name: sheetpane-column-rules
matches.description: Use when the host checks what users type by column title in code - columns, validate(ctx, signal), on-invalid flag or block, header-row. Not for rules shipped as a JSON file (sheetpane-rules-file) or the workbook's own validation (sheetpane-plugins).

matches.name: sheetpane-rules
matches.description: The /sheetpane-rules [workbook or rules file] command - drafts a rules file for a workbook, or fixes one, then runs sheetpane-skills check-rules until it is clean. Not for learning the format (sheetpane-rules-file) or rules in code.
